First published version. An MCP server that lets an AI agent read Microsoft Exchange (EWS), Mail.ru
and Gmail (IMAP) from a local copy, without being able to change the mailbox.

Download `mail-mcp-server.jar`, then follow the
[Quickstart](https://github.com/igorolv/mail-mcp-server#quickstart). It needs JDK 25 and pandoc 3.x.

**Checked on real mail:** Exchange 2013 with NTLM (about 8 thousand messages), Mail.ru (about 34
thousand) and Gmail with an app password. Developed and tested on Windows.

**Known limits**

- Built on release candidates: Spring Boot `4.2.0-RC1` and Spring AI `2.1.0-RC1`.
- Real Gmail OAuth2 sign-in has not been verified.
- Other operating systems run the unit tests in CI but have not been used with real mail.
- Tool responses contain your mail, so your AI client sees what the tools return.
